verdict.summary: No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident. The opt-in feature lane exercises the otherwise skipped window corpus; the window tests cover the real materialized store, inclusive endpoints, fail-closed no-clock behavior, unwindowed-grant isolation, and a mutation witness. Session batching now keys all four dimensions. Issuer and trusted provenance vectors exercise allow, mismatch, missing-evidence, resource-scoping, and cumulative-grant cases through the real runner. The ODRL materialization request using Alice is intentional: the conditional bridge persists Carol's recipient condition for per-session enforcement rather than requiring the materializer to be the recipient. With round 2 already clean and no new findings, progress is stagnant.
